done_when: forge close removes null characters from every text a review returns (titles, bodies, the overall line) before saving it, so a later review or worker round never receives them. One command-level test: a stub reviewer returns a title with null characters, the saved finding has none, and the next close runs.
why: A review once returned a finding title ending in null characters; the next close passed it to the reviewer's command and crashed with 'embedded null byte'
